steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Concept: The Issue Evaluation is Section A of AQA GCSE Geography Paper 3 (Geographical Applications). It tests your ability to use geographical skills, critical thinking, and knowledge to analyse a contemporary geographical issue. You receive pre-release resources 12 weeks before the exam. | Step-by-Step Approach: Read all resources carefully at least twice Annotate key information, patterns, and links between resources Identify the geographical issue and its key components Locate the issue spatially - use maps to understand place context Connect the resources to your wider geographical knowledge Evaluate the reliability and bias of each source | Definition: Stakeholders are individuals, groups, or organisations that have an interest in or are affected by a geographical issue. steps.body: Why is it important to consider the reliability of sources in the pre-release booklet? | Explain why stakeholders often have conflicting viewpoints about geographical issues. | Describe the PEEL structure and explain how it helps you answer evaluation questions.
